changelog: The runtime now answers four verbs — remember, reflect, message, call — and tells the truth about every one of them. vibe_capabilities reports each capability as granted, available, off, or unavailable with its reason (visible even before sign-in); discovery reads no private data and executes nothing. vibe_remember consults your own local memory with a grant or reports its state without one; vibe_reflect reveals your local VibeStats archetype (local-only, never published); vibe_call drafts an explicit live-room handoff that only you can send. Nothing sends, joins, or publishes on its own.
features: vibe_capabilities: the truthful local manifest — remember/reflect/message/call as granted/available/off/unavailable, discovery existence-only
vibe_remember: one sourced offer or silence with a Personal Mind grant; the honest capability state without (vibe_mind name retired)
vibe_reflect: your local VibeStats reveal (archetype + cadence + the provider's own provenance); reflection/no-data/provider-failure/unavailable stay distinct
vibe_call: drafts the live-room handoff line for YOU to approve and send; never sends, joins, or notifies
Local-only verbs carry no ambient footer and their inputs are never retained
